title: One Step, One Rook
setup: The black rook on e4 and the king on c6 sit on the same diagonal with a single empty square between.
hint: Your bishop has one modest step that turns the black rook into a statue. Which diagonal reaches the king?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bf3}} attacks the rook on **e4** and pins it to the king on **c6** in the same move, because the line f3–e4–d5–c6 is clear. The rook has no defender and is not allowed to run, so it drops next move.
